verdicts.reason: Both are nearly the same 320x50 banner with the same flaws: the quote is a tiny three-line italic block at roughly 7px, which is illegible. The gold attribution is bigger and bolder than the quote, which flips the hierarchy, and the orange quote mark floats on its own above it. The can and arc are shrunk to a cramped sliver at the right edge with an unreadable label. A at least keeps a tiny SOLSTICE sun logo, though it is jammed against the bottom edge under the quote. B drops the standalone logo completely and loses some brand presence.
